accusative plural neuter adjective qualifying bhūtarūpāṇi
instrumental singular of trimukha; agent or instrument characterized as three-faced
instrumental singular feminine noun indicating volition or desire
indeclinable adverb indicating manner in accordance with prior instruction

items.question: By whose agency and according to what volition are all spirit-forms to be fashioned?
premises: All spirit-forms are the objects to be fashioned.
A three-faced agent or instrument is involved in the fashioning.
The fashioning proceeds by wish and in the stated manner.
items.inference: All spirit-forms are to be fashioned thus by a three-faced agent according to wish.
uncertainties: Whether trimukhena refers to a three-faced tool, image, or deity is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Thus all the spirit-forms should be made by the three-faced one, according to wish.
